summary: Second correction round for V11 (hub npm test: 306 tests, 305 pass, 1 fail on the conductor's host). The input carries only the tail of the run, not the failing test's name or error. In this sandbox the root node_modules is blocked by a deny rule (ls refused) and the npm registry is closed, so yjs, @hocuspocus/* and dotenv cannot be loaded and the failing test cannot be reproduced. The dependency-free hub tests pass here (155); the other 29 fail only with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. I changed no code or test, because a blind edit could hide a real defect. qualification.md keeps its note that V11 is red (host result 305/306).
